facts.text: Best holiday ever, and we haven't even unpacked. Tonight it's a big steak dinner at the lodge.
facts.why: On the first night Roman turns up uninvited and cooks lobster. The steak challenge happens the next day. Chet says nothing like this in the sources opened.
facts.fix: Quiet week at the lake, I said. Then Roman showed up with lobsters.

vibe.verdict: Good picks (the Old 96er, the bald-headed bear, the water skiing) but the cue, the lake name and the bunk wall note all get the film wrong.
